$meta.name: Travel app design tokens - sprint 4 additions
$meta.status: Draft, pending Raz. DELTA ONLY on top of 0.4.0: every key below is new; no existing value changes. Merge into docs/design/tokens.json and apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts in the same PR that first uses them (docs/design/sprint-04/README.md section 16). Keys starting with '$check.' are contrast documentation only and are not merged into tokens.ts.
color.entry.note: Entry tags (README 5.1). banned = status.alert.bg/fg (needs Raz to extend the Alert rule, question 6); restricted = Sunset 50/700 light, bg.tag/Sunset 300 dark. Always a word plus an icon (no-entry circle / warning triangle), never colour only. allowed = no tag.
color.advisory.note: All filled segments take the level's colour; empty segments are a 1pt outline in advisory.empty with no fill. Bars fill from the start edge (flexDirection row, flips in RTL). Always next to words. Level-4 text uses text.alert; levels 1-3 text.primary (README 6.1, 6.2).
format.rate.note: units = smallest of format.rate.units with rateToIls*units >= 0.1, compared before rounding. ils = toPrecision(2) of rateToIls*units, usd = toPrecision(2) of rateToIls*units/usdIls (from the unrounded value), trailing zeros kept; values >= 100 rounded to 2 significant digits as an integer, never exponent notation. ISO code, not symbol. Thousands with ',' and decimal '.' in both languages. The whole line is wrapped in LRI…PDI. USD: '1 USD = x ₪'. ILS: no line (README 3).
limits.calc.note: '.' and ',' are both the decimal separator; ',' is shown as '.'. A rejected single keystroke is ignored silently; a rejected multi-character change (paste) keeps the previous value and shows calc.invalid. Computed fields: 2 decimals, no grouping; more than 12 integer digits shows an em dash (README 4.2, 4.3).
timing.stale.note: Device clock against fetched_at, checked on each render (no timer).
search.main.note: Countries first (unchanged), then up to 5 cities by population from 2 normalised characters. Group headers only when both groups show. Cities fade in over 150 ms (standard) without moving the countries (README 9).
layout.card.scrollModeRule: Scroll mode when passHeight + COUPON_CHROME + size.tripRow.min > maxCardHeight: pass and coupon in one ScrollView with maxHeight, coupon list unbounded, close button fixed with a 40pt bg.surfaceRaised circle, open trip row scrolled to 16pt below the top (README 1.3).
$check.contrast.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05), on the hex values in tokens.json. Text 4.5:1, graphics 3:1 (1.4.11).
